desc: Disprove the hybrid formula `min(shortest terminal cycle, 2*(dist(S,T)+1))` using the stated 7-move detour-cycle counterexample.
Derive the block-cut-tree characterization: either use the parking maneuver or pass inside one route block via a shortest cycle through that block’s entry/exit vertices.
Formulate an `O((N+M) log N)` implementation using Tarjan vertex-biconnected blocks and two-unit min-cost flow per relevant block.
Validate the implementation against configuration-space BFS reasoning, structural edge cases, and all public samples.
Verify correctness considerations for paths, trees, bridges, articulations, adjacent terminals, parking, and resource bounds.
